promotions.title: $30 off a first order
promotions.terms: New Uber Eats users in Canada; $40 minimum before tax and fees. Apply FIRSTEATS30 or PREMIEREATS30 in the app. Cannot combine; exclusions and other charges apply.

promotions.title: 40% off a first order, up to $13
promotions.terms: New eligible accounts within 45 days of signup; $15 minimum before tax and fees. Delivery only, one use, excludes alcohol. Includes a delivery-fee waiver; service fees and tax still apply. Must appear in your account.

promotions.title: 25% off up to four orders, capped at $8 each
promotions.terms: Only customers sent this offer directly by DoorDash. $15 minimum; enter 25TASTYCA. Fees, tax and tips remain payable. Check the offer’s availability and expiry in your account.

promotions.title: Buy one eligible chicken sandwich, get one free
promotions.terms: Participating Wendy’s locations only. Add two Classic or Spicy Chicken Sandwiches marked eligible in DoorDash. One pair per order; base item price only, while supplies last. Cannot combine; fees and taxes remain.

promotions.title: $20 welcome voucher on a $40 order
promotions.terms: Link an eligible CIBC card to Skip+. The welcome voucher appears in My Skip within 24 hours; $40 minimum before taxes, fees and tips. Requires the voucher in your account.

promotions.title: Skip+ delivery and service-fee benefits
promotions.terms: Requires Skip+ membership and a participating order. Delivery-fee waivers and lower service fees depend on eligibility. Paid membership is $9.99/month plus tax; trial eligibility varies. Confirm checkout fees.

promotions.title: Pickup only: first Original or Veggie burger for $3
promotions.terms: First order through the Harvey’s app with an account. Apply 3BURGER in the Coupons tab. Excludes delivery; taxes, cheese and bacon cost extra. Limited-time offer; cannot combine with other offers.

promotions.title: $5 off a first restaurant-app order of $40+
promotions.terms: Download the Swiss Chalet app and activate the coupon. One use at participating locations for web/app pickup or delivery. $40 minimum excludes tax, tips, alcohol, delivery fees and gift cards. Delivery charges remain; cannot combine.
